acceptance.note: Frozen before breast execution: engineering/plausibility screens plus >=70% retained in every published coarse compartment and resolved capture map. Already-filtered source permits 100% retention. Published labels are not independent truth. No threshold relaxation after a failed screen.

parameters.ambient_rna_policy: Not assessed: upstream filtered author matrices lack empty droplets
parameters.annotation_policy: Breast canonical coarse compartments; T/NK combined because cytotoxic programs overlap and author major T label contains NK; fine labels unreviewed. Same-dataset author labels used only for evaluation.
parameters.miqc_policy: Pinned miQC 1.14.0 linear model, posterior default 0.75, seeds 42/43, agreement >=0.95 for a stable challenger. Diagnostic only: never replaces active QC or uses author labels. Unidentifiable fits produce no-call.
parameters.qc_policy: Breast mixed-tissue capture/sample MAD tails with lower tails capped at p05, no PBMC mt cap or upper-count exclusion
